programme.desc: When Stuart's larger-than-life ex-girlfriend surprises him with a visit, Aja, Steve, Vex, and Nana join them on a triple date— where issues from each of their relationships come to a head. Meanwhile, Krel, Toby, and Eli discover a new passion: Sci-Fi filmmaking.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back In The Crib
programme.desc: Lured into an empty hotel where a baby has supposedly gone missing, the team is trapped by Crispin Biscuits, a chaotic British schoolboy baby who's been hired to wreck Boss and Tina's lives. Crispin puts the new company's loyalty to a test in a series of fiendish puzzling mind games, all with the threat of constant balloon popping (horrible for baby ears!)

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back In The Crib
programme.desc: Our team's startup company and their rivals at Baby Corp get in a “Space Race”, competing to see who can make the cutest kiddie-pretend “moon landing” for a baby - a spectacle sure to bring in a bounty of Baby Love. With both companies pouring their resources into a simulated space take off, tempers and sabotage are running hot, and the scrappy little startup is in danger of getting crushed by their big business competitor.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back In The Crib
programme.desc: JJ reluctantly lets Tina take over her assistant duties for the day, but a Tina slip-up leads to an outbreak of town adults drinking diluted special formula that makes them all baby-brained. When JJ discovers this, she works with R & D Baby Simmons and Security Baby Katja to antidote the wobbling “Adult Babies” before Tina can find out and blame herself.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight
programme.desc: Blade tells Po the truth about Alfie. The group chases after Klaus and Veruca in an epic snowy mountain chase, culminating in Po saving Blade's life as the weasels take off with the gauntlet and the whip. Rukhmini reveals that she actually has the real whip in her staff, and she knows where to go to get the next one: India.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight
programme.desc: The team arrives in India where an old friend of Rukhmini can supposedly give them a pendant that will lead to the next Tianshang weapon. But when they arrive, they find that Rukhmini's hometown has changed a lot in the thirty years she's been gone, and her old friend Diya might not be willing to help them.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight
programme.desc: The team plans a heist in order to obtain the enchanted pendant that can lead them to the storm wheels. Elsewhere, Klaus and Veruca shipwreck on a mysterious island that is actually home to the mages, and also the Tianshang weapon helmet.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free: Pony Tales
programme.desc: While riding back to Miradero, the girls get lost -- and Abigail's horse gets bitten by a snake! Can an old friend's skills help save the day?

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free: Pony Tales
programme.desc: After finding a majestic horse in the wild, Lucky and the girls set out to solve the mystery of where she came from -- and where she truly belongs.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free: Riding Academy
programme.desc: With academy life on the horizon, the PALs work together to tame wild yearling Governor before they leave. But maybe he's not meant to be broken.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods
programme.desc: After getting hit on the head, Eep has a vision and sets out to get the Valley to show how thankful they are; Grug feels like he's the biggest joke in Ahhh Valley, so he asks Thunk to make a “buy-o-pic” of him to show people just how truly great he is

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods
programme.desc: Lerk and Thunk hide all the valley's worms in a cave to protect them from the hunters who want to use them as bait; Grug invents the spear and pitches it to the Valley as a tool that will change cavemanity forever!

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods
programme.desc: Eep, Thunk, Lerk, and Womp set out to make it to the end of “The Tunnel of Terror” within the Cave of Secrets; After being rescued by a mysterious creature at the watering hole, Thunk tries to convince the Valley that a “sea thing” exists and it's not just his imagination

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge
programme.desc: After a strange creature bites Tuffnut, he believes he'll turn into a legendary Lycanwing dragon when the moon is full unless his friends can save him

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge
programme.desc: When Snotlout and Astrid must fly a ceremonial battle axe to a family wedding, they must work together when an Armorwing dragon derails their plan

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge
programme.desc: After heroes Hiccup and Toothless save Barf and Belch's life, the grateful Zippleback tries to repay its life debt and abandons riders Ruff and Tuff

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia
programme.desc: Jim and his friends decide to take a night off for a double date, only to discover an uninvited fifth wheel.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia
programme.desc: When Jim discovers Claire's sickness is much different than an average cold, they must traverse into the dangerous Shadow Realm to save her life.

programme.title: Cinta Kura-kura
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Nani, seorang gadis ceria yang memiliki kura-kura peliharaan bernama Nico yang boleh bercakap. Hidup Nani berubah apabila dua lelaki — Adam dan Fadzly — mula cuba menambat hatinya, sementara Nico pula berusaha melindungi tuannya daripada lelaki yang disyakinya tidak ikhlas.

programme.title: 1 Lawan Satu
programme.desc: Saleh dan Radhi, dua 'pejuang' yang datang dari latar belakang berbeza, namun bertemu di gelanggang pertarungan. Saleh dibesarkan dengan kemahiran seni mempertahankan diri dan kini sedang mencari adiknya yang telah hilang. Radhi pula bertarung demi menyelamatkan adik perempuannya, Sara, yang sedang sakit tenat dan memerlukan RM50,000 untuk rawatan.

programme.title: Tayangan Perdana Flat Simpang Satu
programme.desc: Kisah kehidupan dan perjuangan orangorang kecil kelas bawahan di Flat Simpang Satu yang berlegar dalam himpitan pola kehidupan, bergelumang dalam jalur ekonomi dan politik sesak serta berhadapan dengan perasaan curiga dan mencurigai antara mereka serta kejadian aneh dan menyeramkan yang dilalui oleh 3 orang penghuni flat tersebut. Hanya mereka bertiga sahaja yang tahu kenapa.

programme.title: Pisau Cukur
programme.desc: Apa yang berlaku apabila pemangsa dan mangsa terperangkap di atas kapal persiaran mewah? Dua gadis mata duitan, Bella dan Intan, berhadapan dengan tiga orang Datuk, tiga isteri Datuk, dua anak Datuk, seorang detektif persendirian, dan seorang peminat fanatik Bella. Siapakah pemangsa dan siapakah mangsa? Dalam pelayaran yang penuh dengan kejutan, apa sahaja boleh berlaku!

programme.title: Syawal Mencari Cinta
programme.desc: Pada pagi Raya, Syawal melepak bersama rakannya dan mereka tidak menunaikan solat sunat Hari Raya. Setelah selesai solat sunat Hari Raya, dia ternampak seorang gadis yang tidak pernah dilihatnya di kampung sebelum ini. Syawal terus berkesimpulan bahawa dia telah menemui cinta sejati. Dia telah mengunjung setiap rumah di kampung untuk menjejaki gadis tersebut. Selepas sekian lama mencari tanpa membuahkan hasil, Syawal terus mengumumkan kepada seluruh kampung bahawa dia akan melaksanakan rumah terbuka untuk hari raya dan semua orang dijemput hadir ke rumahnya. Namun demikian, setelah selesai rumah terbukanya, gadis yang dicari-cari Syawal masih tidak kelihatan. Dia kecewa lalu berputus asa. Tanpa sedar, gadis yang dijejaki selama ini adalah Cinta, sepupunya sendiri.

programme.title: Kaki Kitai
programme.desc: Din AKA Drango dan Ayoi adalah dua sahabat yang juga merupakan penipu. Mereka berdua datang ke Kuala Lumpur dan secara tidak sengaja bertemu semula dengan seorang kawan lama yang kini bekerja sebagai pegawai polis. Namun, hidup mereka mula berubah apabila mereka menemui sebuah beg sampah yang dipenuhi dengan wang tunai, yang kemudian mereka gunakan untuk membayar hutang.

programme.title: Istanbul Aku Datang
programme.desc: Seorang gadis muda dari Malaysia pergi ke Istanbul untuk bertemu dengan teman lelaki kesayangannya, namun gadis yang naif itu tidak tahu apa yang akan berlaku kepada kehidupannya di sana.

programme.title: Ruang Temu
programme.desc: Program temu bual bersama Tony Eusoff yang mengupas pengalaman peribadi beliau berkaitan pengalaman beliau di dalam industri seni

programme.title: Jodoh Tak Salah Alamat
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Luqman pernah mengenali seorang gadis bernama Diana ketika Diana melanggar keretanya dahulu. Diana berpenampilan seksi dan mengamalkan cara hidup barat membuatkan Luqman bersangka buruk terhadap Diana. Satu hari, Luqman ke masjid dan terserempak dengan seorang gadis cantik iaitu Adawiyah. Tanpa mengetahui, Adawiyah dan Diana adalah orang yang sama. Diana pernah terlibat dengan kemalangan dan sejak itu hidupnya berubah sepenuhnya.

programme.title: Hayya 1: The Power Of Love
programme.desc: Rahmat, wartawan yang dihantui dosa silam, berhijrah jadi relawan di kem pelarian Palestin dan bertemu Hayya, anak yatim piatu. Pertemuan itu mengubah hidupnya, namun bila dia pulang ke Indonesia untuk berkahwin dengan Yasna, tercetus konflik emosi yang rumit, lucu dan tegang antara mereka.

programme.title: Hayya 2: Dream Hope And Reality
programme.desc: Filem sekuel ini menyorot trauma dan kehilangan. Hayya melarikan diri ke Indonesia lalu bertemu Lia dan Faisal, yang akhirnya menganggapnya sebagai pengikat rumah tangga mereka. Sementara Rahmat, Adhin dan Ricis terus mencarinya, rahsia keluarga Faisal terbongkar hingga tragedi besar berlaku.

programme.title: Ibadah Dalam Islam
programme.desc: Bersama Ustazah Nor Adibah yang akan membincangkan topik mengenai “Bermegah Mengundang Padah”. Program ini menceritakan topik berdasarkan asas-asas ibadah dalam Islam. Melalui program ini penonton akan dapat pelbagai info dan ilmu tentang ciri, matlamat dan tujuan ibadah dalam kehidupan seharian kita.

programme.title: #ustazmasak
programme.desc: Cef Fendi dan Ustaz Jemputan akan mengembara ke destinasi seperti ladang dan tempat perusahaan makanan yang berasaskan bahan masakan yang sering digunakan untuk memasak. Episod kali ini bersama dengan Dai Hafiz sebagai ustaz jemputan dan destinasi mereka kali ini di Selangor Fruit Valley untuk membawakan menu yang berasaskan sayur sawi.

programme.title: Puji Pujian & Kalam Allah V2
programme.desc: Zikir dan bacaan surah-surah lazim.

programme.title: Jom Baca
programme.desc: Episod kali ini ustaz akan mengajar adik-adik membaca surah al-Masad. Perkongsian yang santai dan pembukaan dimulakan dengan Q&A yang menjurus kepada permasalahan, kemusykilan harian yang dihadapi.Ustaz juga akan meminta adik-adik tersebut mengaji surah tersebut dan membetulkan bacaan mana yang salah. Ustaz juga akan mengupas kegunaan serta kebaikan surah tersebut dan akan ada soal jawab bersama adik-adik tersebut.

programme.title: Religious Clip
programme.desc: Dalam episod kali ini, topik yang di sampaikan ialah “Sujud Terakhir”. Bersama Ustaz Izzat yang akan membincangkan topik ini dengan lebih lanjut lagi.

programme.title: Doa
programme.desc: Episod ini akan membincangkan doa mengenai “Doa Terbangun Dari Tidur”. Doa akan membicarakan mengenai doa-doa yang dapat kita gunakan dalam seharian kita bukan sahaja doa selepas solat tetapi solat yang boleh kita amalkan agar terselamat di dunia dan akhirat.

programme.title: Jom Jalan
programme.desc: Jom Jalan akan membawa Selebriti tanah air ke serata pelusuk tanah air. Pada setiap episod Selebriti akan membawa penonton ke destinasi menarik yang meliputi lokasi percutian, lokasi bersejarah, membeli belah dan makanan tempatan. Pada minggu ni Jom Jalan membawa penonton ke Kelantan

programme.title: Wira Yang Tak Didendang
programme.desc: Episod kali ini menceritakan mengenai pusat-pusat pemulihan yang mana menempatkan anak-anak istimewa. Berkorban masa dan tenaga serta menyumbangkan wang ringgit tanpa mengira kepada siapa. Setiap sukarelawan mempunyai kekuatan mereka tersendiri seperti dalam aktiviti yang mereka suka dan mungkin ada sejarah disebalik penglibatan mereka.

programme.title: Religious Clip
programme.desc: Dalam episod kali ini, topik yang di sampaikan ialah "Couple Islamik? (Jagalah Maruah)” Bersama Ustazah Khadijah yang akan membincangkan topik ini dengan lebih lanjut lagi.

programme.title: Bacaan Al-quran V1
programme.desc: Bacaan ayat suci Al Quran

programme.title: Kisah Dalam Al Quran
programme.desc: Dalam episod kali ini ustaz akan membawakan kisah mengenai “Ababil dan Abrahah”. Kisah yang dipaparkan oleh al-Quran adalah sebahagian daripada tanda-tanda mukjizat kerana ia menceritakan mengenai umat terdahulu yang sebahagian besar tidak diketahui.

programme.title: Tanam Apa Tuu?
programme.desc: Raze mengalami pelbagai kejutan setelah dia sampai di kampung atuknya. Raze juga melakukan pelbagai perkara baharu yang tidak pernah dia lakukan ketika di bandar antaranya bermulalah titik awal Raze menceburi bidang perkebunan.

programme.title: Hadis
programme.desc: Episod ini akan membincangkan hadis daripada Anas bin Malik yang diriwayatkan oleh Imam Bukhari mengenai memudahkan urusan agama. Hadis akan membicarakan mengenai hadis-hadis nabi S.A.W yang menjadi panduan di dalam kehidupan kita.

programme.title: Menu Viral
programme.desc: Episod kali ini bersama Cef Naem akan berada di Nasi Lemak Wanjo. Cef akan merasa menu yang viral tersebut sebelum berjumpa dengan tukang masak restoran untuk melihat sendiri resipi yang digunakan.

programme.title: Adab Dalam Islam
programme.desc: Topik yang akan dibincangkan dalam episod kali ini ialah “Adab Menziarahi Kubur”. Apakah adab-adab yang telah diajar orleh Islam dan Nabi Muhammad ketika kita menziarahi kubur? . Bersama dengan Prof Madya Dato Dr. Izhar Ariff yang akan menghuraikan topik ini dengan lebih lanjut.

programme.title: Coklat Rasa Cinta
programme.desc: Alma begitu gemar membakar kuih dan kek untuk diberikan kepada orang lain. Ibunya menyarankan dia menjual disamping memberi kawan-kawannya. Marel yang pada mulanya tidak suka dengan Alma lama kelamaan jatuh hati dengan Alma. Perniagaan Alma akhirnya berjaya dengan bantuan kawan-kawan dan keluarganya.

programme.title: Jejak Rasul - Sutera Laut Bicara Syahadah
programme.desc: Satun mempunyai sejarah yang berkait rapat dengan kesultanan Melayu Kedah. Episod ini akan menampilkan dua orang wira tempatan yang memperjuangkan hak penduduk serta pengembang ajaran Islam. Kedua-kedua mereka dipercayai berasal dari keturunan pedagang-pedagang Parsi.

programme.title: Puji Pujian & Kalam Allah V1
programme.desc: Zikir dan bacaan surah-surah lazim.

programme.title: Religious Clip
programme.desc: Dalam episod kali ini, topik yang di sampaikan ialah "Jangan Sombong” Bersama Ustaz Safwan Idris yang akan membincangkan topik ini dengan lebih lanjut lagi.

programme.title: Superhero Hati
programme.desc: Suhana yang terlalu kecewa dengan takdir yang menimpa telah mengurungkan dirinya selama seminggu tanpa bercakap dengan sesiapa. Sebaik Akasyah dengar berita itu, dia telah berkejar ke kampung Suhana dan menyatakan rasa cintanya yang dipendam sejak zaman kolej mereka lagi. Namun pengakuan itu membuatkan Suhana menjadi marah sehingga menghalau Akasyah. Berkat pujukan dan nasihat ibunya, Suhana akhirnya bangkit semula dari kekecewaan itu. Sesampainya di KL dia telah dikejutkan dengan berita Adam yang sakit teruk akibat merindui Suhana.

programme.title: Sahabat Sahabat Nabi
programme.desc: Episod ini akan membicarakan mengenai sahabat nabi iaitu Said bin Amir Al-Jumahi r.a. Umat Islam yang dikenali sahabat nabi dianggap mempunyai hubungan terus dengan Nabi Muhammad s.a.w dan mereka bukanlah pendusta atau menentang ajaran Islam. Jika meraka melihatnya, mendengarnya, atau berada di hadapan baginda walau sekejap mereka dianggap sebagai sahabat nabi s.a.w.

programme.title: Periuk Belanga
programme.desc: Episod kali ini bersama artis jemputan Laila Nasir yang akan menyajikan “Sambal Tumis Sardin” makanan berkonsepkan outdoor dan akan beraktiviti serta berkhemah di sebuah tapak perkhemahan yang dikelilingi oleh hutan.

programme.title: Alhamdulillah
programme.desc: Episod Alhamdulillah kali ini bersama Ummi Nazeera menemu bual usahawan Bizmila Catering yang akan merungkai rahsia di sebalik kejayaan personaliti yang berjaya di Malaysia bagaimana permulaan kehidupan mereka untuk hidup dan kisah kejayaan seseorang usahawan dalam bidang yang diusahakan.

programme.title: Puji Pujian & Kalam Allah V2
programme.desc: Zikir dan bacaan surah-surah lazim.

programme.title: Religious Clip

programme.title: Mr Millennium
programme.desc: Jamil mengekori Qistina dan asyik memanggil Qistina dengan nama Mastora. Ketika Jamil asyik mengekori Qistina, secara tiba-tiba ada sebuah kereta muncul dan menculik Jamil. Jamil terkejut bila dirinya tiba-tiba sahaja berada di dalam sebuah kereta, puas Jamil bertanya siapa mereka tetapi tiada jawapan. Jamil memanggil Qistina dari dalam kereta, dia asyik mengatakan bahawa dia mahu berjumpa dengan gadis cantik bernama Qistina itu namun permintaan Jamil tidak diendahkan oleh mereka yang menculiknya.

programme.title: Jom Solat
programme.desc: Dalam episod ini ustaz akan membincangkan dengan sahabat jom solat mengenai rukun seterusnya iaitu duduk tasyahud awal dan tasyahud akhir. Jom Solat menampilakan Ustaz Dr Taha yang akan memberi panduan mengenai cara-cara solat dengan betul dan tertib. Bersama menemani ustaz sahabat jom solat iaitu Khalidah Balqis dan Asyraff Roslee.

programme.title: Hidayah Klip
programme.desc: Episod kali ini, menemu bual seorang artis antarabangsa Maher Zain yang popular dengan lagu Insy-Allah. Maher Zain mengeluarkan single terbaru beliau yang bertajuk The Power yang berkonsepkan ketuhanan yang menyentuh kehebatan mereka yang sentiasa berzikir mengingati Allah. Penulis liriknya Moh Denebi dan Maher Zain sendiri. Penulis lirik untuk bahasa inggeris iaitu Bara Kherigi dan Paddy Dalton. Maher Zain mendapat inspirasi sepenuhnya daripada Al-Quran.

programme.title: Ustaz Kita
programme.desc: Episod ini akan membincangkan mengenai “Rawatan Dan Kosmetik Gigi”. Ustaz Kita akan membicarakan mengenai topik yang menarik mengenai isu-isu fiqh dan fatwah semasa Ustaz akan membincangkan sepanjang dalam perbincangan setiap episod perkara-perkara yang boleh mendatangkan ilmu kepada kita.

programme.title: Asbab Al Nuzul
programme.desc: Episod ini akan menerangkan surah 'Abasa. Asbab Al Nuzul yang akan menjelaskan persoalan-persoalan yang menyebabkan turunnya satu-satu ayat atau beberapa ayat untuk menerangkan peristiwa dan hukumnya turunnya ayat Al- Quran. Ia berkaitan dengan beberapa ayat untuk menerangkan hal yang berhubungan dengan peristiwa tertentu atau memberikan jawapan tertentu dalam bahagian dari ilmu tafsir Qur'an.

programme.title: Kisah Dalam Al Quran
programme.desc: Dalam episod kali ini ustaz akan membawakan kisah mengenai "Kisah Fitnah ke atas Aisyah dan Bahaya Fitnah”. Kisah yang dipaparkan oleh al-Quran adalah sebahagian daripada tanda-tanda mukjizat kerana ia menceritakan mengenai umat terdahulu yang sebahagian besar tidak diketahui.

programme.title: Ustazah Biker
programme.desc: Apabila Danny tahu Airra berjumpa lagi dengan Ziyad, Danny mengamuk. Kali ini dia benar-benar hilang pertimbangan. Dia pergi ke rumah Airra dan melempang Airra dengan kuat. Dia cuba memukul Airra lagi. Mujurlah Cik Tom yang berada di dalam rumah nampak. Cik Tom marah dan dia mengambil kayu dan memukul Danny dengan kuat. Cik Tom mula sedar yang Danny bukan pilihan yang baik untuk Airra. Sekalipun Danny meminta ampun di atas apa yang dilakukannya tehadap Airra, namun hati Cik Tom sudah terluka melihat perbuatan Danny kepada Airra.

programme.title: Coklat Rasa Cinta
programme.desc: Alma begitu gemar membakar kuih dan kek untuk diberikan kepada orang lain. Ibunya menyarankan dia menjual disamping memberi kawan-kawannya. Marel yang pada mulanya tidak suka dengan Alma lama kelamaan jatuh hati dengan Alma. Perniagaan Alma akhirnya berjaya dengan bantuan kawan-kawan dan keluarganya.

programme.title: Pembancuh Kopi Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Selepas berkahwin, Irsyad mendesak Nuzul untuk memberitahunya punca Nuzul meninggalkannya empat tahun lepas namun Nuzul berkeras untuk tidak memberitahunya. Irsyad sudah memasang strategi untuk Nuzul. Selagi Nuzul tidak berterus-terang dengannya selagi itulah dia merasakan ada yang kurang dalam rumahtangganya.

programme.title: Lelaki Melayu Terakhir
programme.desc: Qasih menyahut cabaran untuk menjadi isteri yang solehah dengan mengemas rumah dan memasak untuk suaminya. Jazlan pula merasakan yang beliau gagal menjadi seorang suami yang baik kerana tidak dapat membentuk isterinya menjadi isteri yang solehah. Masakan yang dimasak Qasih melalui youtube menyebabkan Jazlan bangun di tengah malam dan bergegas ke bilik air, keesokannya Jazlan sakit kepala dan demam. Salah seorang pelajar Arab yang dibimbing Jazlan menghantarkan nasi arab ke rumah yang membuatkan Qasih cemburu dan sakit hati kerana beliau telah mula mencintai Jazlan. Setelah keadaan sebenarnya diterangkan Qasih dan Jazlan mula bermesra dan bergurau senda menjalani kehidupan sebagai suami isteri dengan penuh bahagia

programme.title: Dapur Bujang Ramadan 2024
programme.desc: Rancangan ini memaparkan Chef Naem yang akan berkongsi menu masakan yang mudah dan enak sempena bulan Ramadan. Dalam episod kali ini, Chef akan menyediakan Tomyam Campur & Ayam Oats Masala

programme.title: Another Love
programme.desc: Leyla mengesyaki pembunuhan bersifat peribadi. Kenan, mula menerima mesej tanpa nama yang membayangkan konspirasi yang lebih besar. Bapanya, Turan Öztürk, seorang tokoh yang dihormati, memberi amaran kepadanya untuk menjauhkan diri daripada kes itu.

programme.title: Sudirman Chow Kit Road
programme.desc: Sudirman Chow Kit Road! merupakan sebuah dokumentari yang mengupas perjalanan dan kenangan nostalgia seorang lelaki berbadan kecil tetapi mempunyai jiwa yang besar, Sudirman Haji Arshad untuk mengadakan konsert percuma yang menyatukan rakyat malaysia berbilang kaum di tengah tengah jalan Chow Kit dan ianya merupakan satu fenomena besar suatu ketika dahulu, sehinggakan ianya masih terpahat di hati rakyat Malaysia

programme.title: Kerana Cinta Itu Dusta
programme.desc: Seri mula goyah apabila gambarnya tanpa tudung diviralkan, menimbulkan kritikan tajam netizen dan rasa maruah tercalar. Sufian spin naratif, cuba alih isu dan pujuk Seri bertahan walaupun hatinya rapuh. Hanis terus provok Orked, tetapi Orked tetap tenang dan bersama Mikael mengambil langkah strategik. Orked hadir ke mahkamah bersama peguam, memfailkan tuntutan penjagaan penuh anak-anak, menegaskan hak dan maruahnya sebagai ibu. Sufian menafikan, menuduh Orked cemburu dan memanipulasi imej, sementara Seri menuntut kepastian dalam hubungan dengan Sufian. Keluarga Seri menentang perkahwinan mereka, tetapi Sufian berkeras, didukung Zaleha, menjadikan Seri merasa seperti patung dalam permainan mereka. Orked semakin berani, muncul di TV dengan kata-kata tegas menegakkan hak dan maruah, sekaligus memperlihatkan kekuatannya di mata netizen.

programme.title: Mr Delicious
programme.desc: Aiman akhirnya berani membuat pilihan muktamad, walaupun risikonya amat besar.

programme.title: Akil & juan
programme.desc: Juan, remaja Sarawak yang bercita-cita menjadi askar, ke Kuala Lumpur dan membantu kerja amal bersama abangnya. Di sana, dia mengenali Akil, rakan sebaya yang hidup susah dan berkorban demi keluarga, membuka mata Juan tentang realiti kehidupan bandar.

programme.title: Pembancuh Kopi Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Semenjak Nuzul berhenti kerja dan menjadi suri rumah sepenuh masa, kehidupannya terasa bosan. Menjadi suri rumah menjarakkan lagi hubungannya dengan Irsyad. Nuzul buntu. Kadang-kala Nuzul akan ke Rayyan Café untuk bertemu Laila. Laila dan Saiful ada juga cuba mengorek dengannya tentang punca dia melarikan diri dulu namun Nuzul tetap tetap dengan pendiriannya. Dia tidak akan membocorkan rahsianya itu kerana dia takut hal itu akan menggoyahkan hubungan ibu dan anak.

Apabila dia pulang ke kampung bersama ibunya untuk bercuti, pelbagai gangguan misteri dan gangguan makhluk halus mula berlaku sepanjang perjalanan pulang menjadikan balik kampungnya lebih mencemaskan daripada yang dijangka

programme.title: Pembancuh Kopi Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Semenjak Nuzul berhenti kerja dan menjadi suri rumah sepenuh masa, kehidupannya terasa bosan. Menjadi suri rumah menjarakkan lagi hubungannya dengan Irsyad. Nuzul buntu. Kadang-kala Nuzul akan ke Rayyan Café untuk bertemu Laila. Laila dan Saiful ada juga cuba mengorek dengannya tentang punca dia melarikan diri dulu namun Nuzul tetap tetap dengan pendiriannya. Dia tidak akan membocorkan rahsianya itu kerana dia takut hal itu akan menggoyahkan hubungan ibu dan anak.

programme.title: Lubuk
programme.desc: Rancangan khas yang akan membawa anda ke tempat menarik dari sungai hinggalah ke tempat tersembunyi untuk memancing.

programme.title: Terbaik Dari Jalanan
programme.desc: Ikuti Suffren dan Banni dalam jelajah mereka menikmati makanan-makanan terbaik dari gerai, warung dan kedai kaki lima. Tak lupa juga, cerita-cerita jatuh bangun disebalik setiap peniaga.

programme.title: Dapur Bujang Ramadan 2024
programme.desc: Rancangan ini memaparkan Chef Naem yang akan berkongsi menu masakan yang mudah dan enak sempena bulan Ramadan. Dalam episod kali ini, Chef akan menyediakan Ikan Bakar Terung & Mi Siput Manis.

programme.title: Tayangan Perdana Flat Simpang Satu
programme.desc: Nantikan Flat Simpang Satu yang akan disiarkan pada 21 March hanya di unifi TV

programme.title: SLAM bersama MPO
programme.desc: Saksikan malam penuh nostalgia apabila Malaysian Philharmonic Orchestra bergabung dengan kumpulan popular 90-an, SLAM, dalam sebuah konsert istimewa di pentas DFP. Nikmati lagu-lagu hit era pop melankolik yang diolah dengan sentuhan orkestra penuh elegan, menyatukan keharmonian muzik simfoni dan energi bertenaga SLAM dalam kolaborasi luar biasa ini.

programme.title: Kerana Cinta Itu Dusta
programme.desc: Perkahwinan Sufian dan Seri menjadi tular, Seri gembira menempatkan gambarnya bersama Saif dan Putri di bingkai yang sebelum ini milik Orked. Puan Lela kecewa kerana tidak dibawa bersama, manakala Orked terpaku tetapi tenang, menyedari ini strategi Sufian untuk mengekalkan penjagaan anak. Seri meniru peranan Orked, menguruskan rumah dan anak-anak untuk media sosial, tetapi mendapat kritikan netizen kerana perbandingan dengan Orked. Sufian pula dibebani tuntutan nafkah dan harta sepencarian dari Orked, yang diurus dengan matang dan strategik, disokong Mikael. Saif kelihatan murung walaupun ada ibu baru. Orked menyusun strategi tersendiri, tampil dalam podcast menegaskan haknya sebagai ibu tunggal, menekankan anak-anak membesar tanpa tekanan memilih pihak, dan memperoleh sokongan netizen. Seri semakin tertekan apabila Sufian lebih fokus pada imej dan perhatian Orked, manakala jualan sambal Seri merosot

programme.title: Ninaivo Oru Paravai
programme.desc: Penyanyi terkenal bernama Chandru yang mengalami hilang ingatan bertemu dengan seorang pemuzik jalanan, Kathira. Mereka bekerjasama dalam muzik meskipun mempunyai latar dan cara hidup yang berbeza. Namun, timbul misteri apabila Kathira sebenarnya mempunyai hubungan masa lalu dengan Chandru dan merancang semua ini untuk membantunya keluar dari kegelapan dan kembali ke pentas.

programme.title: Stylish Man-The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man The Chef is co-hosted by the Golden Bell Awards winner Sam Tseng and Genie Chuo, together with professional chef, James. There are two main themes for the program, which are Big Stars Come to Cook and Five-Star Cooking Show. Stylish Man The Chef containing not only the bomb of laughter, but the audience can also gain practical cooking knowledge throughout the program.

programme.title: Blessing of Formosa
programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life. This program showcases folk culture regardless of race or religion, and presents travel information in a fun way, combining easy-to-understand folk culture knowledge with the mission of passing on folk culture. The audience can learn more about folk cultural products such as handicrafts, antiques, temple folklore, as well as short stories about the gods, and information about local tourism. It is an educational and entertaining way to travel and learn about folklore.

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Different in age, generation, and hosting style, these three hosts not only can sing, act, dance, and imitate, but are also skilled in cross-talk! With this unique combination, we hope to attract viewers of all ages and spark great entertainment.

programme.desc: Wu is a senior police officer has always wanted a son to carry his family name and join the force. However, he and wife are bequeathed with four daughters! As a doting father, his chief objective is to help them find happiness in their marriages. In this charming drama, Wu & his wife become their daughters greatest haven, through the ups and downs they face as married women.

programme.title: Ke Medan Jaya
programme.desc: Hisham tinggal bersama ibunya, Mak Jah. Bapanya yang bekerja sebagai anggota tentera telah meninggal dunia akibat serangan musuh semasa zaman darurat. Sejak kematian suaminya, Mak Jah bekerja sebagai pembantu rumah dengan seorang hartawan bernama Pak Samad. Pak Samad dan isterinya tidak pernah menganggap Mak Jah sebagai pembantu rumah, malah Hisham dianggap seperti anak mereka sendiri dan mendapat pendidikan yang sama dengan Haryati, anak hartawan tersebut. Apabila wujud kemesraan antara mereka berdua, ibu bapa Haryati merasa bimbang kerana Haryati telah ditunangkan dengan Shahril. Setelah mengetahui kisah sebenar, Hisham mengambil Keputusan untuk menyertai angkatan tentera walaupun ditentang oleh ibunya.

programme.title: Sepet
programme.desc: Sepasang kekasih melalui pelbagai halangan dalam percintaan kerana keduanya berasal dari latar belakang yang berbeza. Orked mencintai Jason yang berbangsa Cina dan bukan beragama Islam. Disebabkan itu pelbagai tekanan terpaksa mereka hadapi kerana stereotaip bangsa dan berlainan agama namun berjaya mereka hadapinya bersama-sama.

programme.title: Cinta Metropolitan
programme.desc: Haris, seorang jurugambar bertemu semula dengan adiknya yang terkenal sebagai seorang casanova, Irwan. Tidak begitu senang dengan perangai adiknya yang suka menggoda sesiapa sahaja termasuk kekasihnya sendiri, hubungan mereka renggang. Satu sindiket pemalsuan wang terbongkar menyebabkan Haris, Irwan, Monisa dan dua orang lagi diburu sindiket itu sehingga ke luar negara.

programme.title: Warna-Warna Hati
programme.desc: Kisah seorang wanita yang terpaksa menguruskan sebuat syarikat besar tanpa bantuan keluarganya. Perniagaan syarikat milik keluarga Puan Rohani mengalami pelbagai masalah selepas Encik Osman, pengurus syarikat tersebut terlibat dalam kes penyelewengan wang syarikat. Anak-anak Puan Rohani yang tidak berminat untuk membantu ibunya dan mengambil tahu mengenai syarikat tersebut menyebabkan Puan Rohani memberi kepercayaan kepada Encik Osman. Puan Rohani juga cuba memujuk anak lelakinya, Hafsham yang baru tamat pengajian dari Amerika Syarikat untuk bekerja di syarikat itu dan membantunya untuk menguruskan syarikat

programme.title: SH3
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang percintaan dan persaingan siapa yang terbaik antara pemain papan selaju ketika kemuncak musik Hip Hop dan sukan papan selaju di negara. Khairul, ingin menjadi pemain papan selaju yang terbaik tetapi menemui kesulitan kerana lawannya, Mario yang juga sama mahir. Ingin memenangi hati Nelly, Khairul ingin terus membuktikan kehandalannya. Pada masa yang sama, Mario dan Mawar berpakat bersama-sama untuk memastikan mereka mendapat Khairul dan Nelly untuk diri mereka sendiri. Sikap setiakawan dan keluarga menjadi penyokong kuat Khairul untuk berjaya.

programme.title: Maria Mariana 2
programme.desc: Maria dikejarkan ke hospital dan menemui cinta bersama doktor yang menyelamatkannya. Kemudiannya, dia ditugaskan untuk membanteras sindiket pengedaran dadah. Hubungan Maria dan Mariana kembali tegang apabila bekas kekasih Mariana muncul kembali. Cara hidup liar Mariana menyebabkan dia diperalatkan dan menimbulkan kekacauan dalam hidup mereka.

programme.title: Sepi
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tiga orang yang berasingan mengenal erti cinta, kehilangan dan kesepian. Adam, seorang tukang masak terkenal yang meluaskan kerjayanya dengan mereka hiasan untuk majlis perkahwinan. Tetapi, dengan segala kejayaan itu beliau masih membujang dan belum bertemu jodohnya sendiri. Sufi pula seorang lelaki yang sedang cuba melenyapkan memori kematian isterinya. Akhir sekali, Iman, seorang penulis muda yang menjadikan pentas teater sebagai tapak untuk memahami masa silamnya dan kupasan demi kupasan ke dalam masa depannya sendiri. Ketiga-tiga watak ini akhirnya terkait dalam satu insiden dramatik yang akan merubah kehidupan mereka buat selamanya.

programme.title: Maria Mariana 1
programme.desc: Dua beradik berbeza perwatakan - Maria, anak kebanggaan keluarga yang cemerlang dalam pelajaran - manakala Mariana, anak yang sering memberontak dan liar. Maria membesar menjadi seorang anggota polis namun Mariana masih sama seperti dahulu. Persengketaan terjadi apabila keduanya menyukai lelaki yang sama. Diculik geng, Maria sanggup menaruhkan nyawa demi menyelamatkan Mariana.

programme.title: Castello
programme.desc: Solo mula menjalankan kegiatan sebagai pengedar dadah untuk menjadikan kehidupan keluarganya lebih mewah. Tapi Solo tertangkap dan dia dipenjara selama 20 tahun. Di dalam penjara, dia dikenali sebagai Castello. Keluar dari penjara, Castello cuba mengesan semula isteri dan anaknya. Tapi dia kecewa bila mengetahui anak gadisnya Phim telah menjadi penagih dadah. Castello berusaha untuk menyelamatkan Phim yang tidak menyedari bahawa Castello adalah bapanya

programme.title: Gemilang
programme.desc: Julia merupakan seorang penyanyi yang mencapai kejayaan di atas sokongan seorang hartawan bernama Razlan. Rita, teman baik Julia pula merupakan seorang artis terkenal dan menganggap Julia sebagai sumber inspirasinya. Julia merasakan keselamatan dirinya terancam apabila gerak-gerinya sering diawasi oleh seorang lelaki misteri.

programme.title: Shining Just for You
programme.desc: The fantasy period drama "Shining Just for You" tells the story of Ye Ling Shuang (played by Peng Xiaoran), a grassland girl who is considered a jinx by her tribe because she can foresee disasters. Only Princess Qi Hai Rui (played by Liu Mengrui) of Ye Bei treats her like a sister. Ye Bei, overestimating its strength, launches a war against the Chao Kingdom, suffering a crushing defeat and losing many soldiers. Ye Ling Shuang is taken prisoner and sent to a brothel, but she refuses to submit. Using her talent for astrology, she enters the Imperial Observatory and gradually wins the heart of the ruthless emperor Yu Xiu Ming (played by Feng Shaofeng). However, just as their friendship deepens, Ye Ling Shuang learns of Qi Hai Rui's death and breaks ties with Yu Xiu Ming. Determined to save Qi Hai Rui, Ye Ling Shuang reverses time and returns to the Ye Bei of the past. Can she change what has already happened? And what will become of her relationship with Yu Xiu Ming?

programme.title: News At 18:30
programme.desc: Jade Channel reports important local, cross-strait, and international news every afternoon at 6:30.

programme.title: Shock Mystery (Sr.2) & What's On Today
programme.desc: Human beings are innately curious about the unknown. Some even believe that not everything in life can be explained solely by scientific or physical phenomena. Even when there appears to be an acceptable answer on the surface, it may not fully resolve all our questions. The production team of " Shock Mystery" has collected hundreds of strange and unusual cases from around the world, most of which cannot be explained from the perspectives commonly accepted by people—unless supernatural phenomena truly exist in our world! This program will introduce you to incredible mysteries that not only existed in the past but still persist today!

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Lo And Behold
programme.desc: HUNG SHU-KAN (Lau Dan) built his own logistics business from scratch and now everything is in order. The only thing on his mind is the well-being of his three daughters. His eldest daughter has moved abroad, but his second youngest daughter, HUNG YUEK-SHUI (Koni Lui), is still single. She and her little prodigy sister, HUNG SUM-YUE (Andrea So), often fight over small things, putting their father in dilemmas.

programme.title: Pretty Dangerous
programme.desc: Some dope called Powder Gremlin is everywhere in the city. Undercover cop Poon Yik-fung (Mark Ma) has been mingling with wise guys and eventually brings narcotic chemist Kuen Sai-ho to justice, but the crook only receives a lenient sentence! Yik-fung asks his boss to consider extending the undercover operation with permission to recruit a contingent of undercover policewomen, and the aim is to investigate the mysterious mastermind behind Sai-ho's scheme. Yik-fung selects three pretty female decoys, each with their unique talents: Shum Kai-kei (Kelly Cheung), aka Female Sherlock Holmes; Kong Miu-chi (Jeannie Chan), aka Meticulous and Sharp-witted Martial Arts Expert; and Tung Siu-yue (Yuki Law), aka Ever-changing Walking Encyclopedia. They have to get close to philanthropic businessman Lau Biu (Eddie Kwan) and his wife Bonnie Ka (Maggie Shiu), and the only obstacle is their daughter Lau Po-yee (Yumi Chung). However, Yik-fung has some hidden agenda as he pushes the female decoys to carry out risky tasks.

programme.title: Imperial Coroner, The (II)
programme.desc: The story of the aloof Prince An, Xiao Jinyu, and Chu Chu, the imperial-appointed female coroner, after their marriage! Their careers, relationships, and overall perspectives are all upgraded. Together with the youth team of the Three Judicial Offices, they uncover the truth and solve bizarre cases, working hand in hand to safeguard the peace of the Tang Dynasty.

programme.title: Road Trip Down Under
programme.desc: Two groups of celebrity friends embarked on a unique road trip adventure in Australia, showcasing their genuine interactions. Wayne Lai, Edwin Siu, and Raymond Cho, who forged an unbreakable friendship over a decade ago on the set of the TV series "The Confidant" reunited for another memorable journey. The three brothers explored stunning scenery, experienced local culture, and shared heartfelt conversations about their careers and families. Karl Ting, Jinny Ng, and Joey Thye, known as best friends in the entertainment industry, traveled together to Queensland and other destinations, combining work with leisure. The friends shared beautiful natural landscapes, diverse food and entertainment, and sparked hilarious moments!

We even travel abroad to cover major entertainment events, track international movie stars, and conduct exclusive interviews with well-known singers, actors, and television personalities familiar to our audience—ensuring you can instantly grasp the latest happenings and news in the world of film and entertainment.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. She discovers everybody's issues before her 70th birthday. Her eldest son Kwok Tak-kan's (Joe Ma) business has failed, and he is also divorcing his wife Tian Yu-fei (Natalie Tong). Her second daughter Kwok Tak-bo (Che Yuen Yuen) and her son Kwok King-hin (Fei Wu) are drifting apart, and her relationship with her boyfriend has also ended. Her youngest son Kwok Tak-ming (Mat Yeung) loses his job as Tak-kan has got him into trouble. While Mei-lan wants to help her children solve their problems, she also plans to team up with her favorite disciple Chong Zi-chang (Grace Wong) to pass down the craft. Meanwhile, Tak-kan and his siblings keep contradicting each other. And gangster Kwok Chung-shek (Eddie Kwan) abruptly shows up and claims he has 50% ownership of the Kwoks' property. Can Mei-lan's strict adherence to the Kwoks motto “Keep walking and there's a way out” unite family members in the confrontation against the enemy?

programme.title: Lo And Behold

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Road Trip Down Under & What's On Today
programme.desc: Two groups of celebrity friends embarked on a unique road trip adventure in Australia, showcasing their genuine interactions. Wayne Lai, Edwin Siu, and Raymond Cho, who forged an unbreakable friendship over a decade ago on the set of the TV series "The Confidant" reunited for another memorable journey. The three brothers explored stunning scenery, experienced local culture, and shared heartfelt conversations about their careers and families. Karl Ting, Jinny Ng, and Joey Thye, known as best friends in the entertainment industry, traveled together to Queensland and other destinations, combining work with leisure. The friends shared beautiful natural landscapes, diverse food and entertainment, and sparked hilarious moments!

programme.title: Profession Impossible
programme.desc: To showcase the talents of local fashion designers, TVB specially produced a fashion design competition reality show. Ten contestants advanced from the preliminary rounds to the semi-finals, each designing two pieces for their collaborating artists based on environmental and Chinese themes, competing for five spots in the finals. The final five faced a final test, creating two outfits each based on a unisex and evening gown theme, which they then paired with their artists to showcase their style on the Catwalk stage, where the champion, first runner-up, and second runner-up were determined! Hosts Nancy Wu and Benjamin Yuen, along with "star" judges Walter Ma, William So, Gigi Leung, Kathy Chow, Amanda S., and others, witnessed the journey of "The Tailoring Magician".

programme.title: Pretty Dangerous
programme.desc: Some dope called Powder Gremlin is everywhere in the city. Undercover cop Poon Yik-fung (Mark Ma) has been mingling with wise guys and eventually brings narcotic chemist Kuen Sai-ho to justice, but the crook only receives a lenient sentence! Yik-fung asks his boss to consider extending the undercover operation with permission to recruit a contingent of undercover policewomen, and the aim is to investigate the mysterious mastermind behind Sai-ho's scheme. Yik-fung selects three pretty female decoys, each with their unique talents: Shum Kai-kei (Kelly Cheung), aka Female Sherlock Holmes; Kong Miu-chi (Jeannie Chan), aka Meticulous and Sharp-witted Martial Arts Expert; and Tung Siu-yue (Yuki Law), aka Ever-changing Walking Encyclopedia. They have to get close to philanthropic businessman Lau Biu (Eddie Kwan) and his wife Bonnie Ka (Maggie Shiu), and the only obstacle is their daughter Lau Po-yee (Yumi Chung). However, Yik-fung has some hidden agenda as he pushes the female decoys to carry out risky tasks.

The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. programme.title: The Taste Of Us
programme.desc: Delicious food, bursting with color, aroma, and flavor, not only fills the stomach but also soothes the soul! Liangliang (Mason Fung), a freelancer who loves singing and food, is feeling lost after breaking up with his girlfriend Jessica (Carmen Ngai). To prove his financial independence, he rents out his vacant room. His tenant, Azhi (Zeno Koo ), is a cooking enthusiast who frequently unleashes his culinary skills, creating a variety of heartwarming dishes such as "Miso Clam Soup" and "Chicken and Avocado Mexican Rolls"... The two young men hit it off immediately, satisfying each other's hunger and filling each other's voids! What kind of interesting relationship will these two very different personalities build?

programme.title: Carbon Cutting for a Greener Future
programme.desc: Global warming is leading to more frequent extreme weather events, prompting an increasing number of businesses to embrace green and low-carbon transformations to address the climate crisis, creating a vast economic development sector. Addressing climate change is not only the responsibility of our generation but also a challenge for future generations. Therefore, developing green and low-carbon transformations is an essential issue for society today. As a leading media organization in Hong Kong, TVB is hosting the "TVB Green Summit" to promote sustainable development. The summit invites government officials, business leaders, and economists to discuss how to seize the economic opportunities presented by low-carbon transformation, encourage more businesses to leverage local advantages to develop green technologies and green finance, and promote sustainable development practices for the entire population, working towards net-zero carbon emissions in the future!

programme.title: Shining Just for You
programme.desc: The fantasy period drama "Shining Just for You" tells the story of Ye Ling Shuang (played by Peng Xiaoran), a grassland girl who is considered a jinx by her tribe because she can foresee disasters. Only Princess Qi Hai Rui (played by Liu Mengrui) of Ye Bei treats her like a sister. Ye Bei, overestimating its strength, launches a war against the Chao Kingdom, suffering a crushing defeat and losing many soldiers. Ye Ling Shuang is taken prisoner and sent to a brothel, but she refuses to submit. Using her talent for astrology, she enters the Imperial Observatory and gradually wins the heart of the ruthless emperor Yu Xiu Ming (played by Feng Shaofeng). However, just as their friendship deepens, Ye Ling Shuang learns of Qi Hai Rui's death and breaks ties with Yu Xiu Ming. Determined to save Qi Hai Rui, Ye Ling Shuang reverses time and returns to the Ye Bei of the past. Can she change what has already happened? And what will become of her relationship with Yu Xiu Ming?

programme.title: News At 18:30
programme.desc: Jade Channel reports important local, cross-strait, and international news every afternoon at 6:30.

programme.title: Vital Lifeline & What's On Today
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. "The Strongest Lifeline" helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the “Sanfu” herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.title: News Roundup
programme.desc: Reporting major news from Hong Kong, across the Taiwan Strait, and around the world, as well as sports updates, keeping you informed about important events and trends in the world of sports.

programme.title: Global View
programme.desc: " Global View," curated by seasoned journalists, guides you to view the world with a global perspective—broadening your horizons, expanding your understanding of the news, and enriching your knowledge.

programme.title: Storm In A Cocoon
programme.desc: Wing Tai Lung is the silk kingdom in Canton during the early years of Republic China. Its owner POON WING-NIN (Yueh Hua), because of his advanced age, has handed over the charge to his elder son POON KA-HIN (Evergreen Mak) and daughter POON HAU-YEE (Hong Wah). Out of the blue, HAU-YEE commits suicide, so his second son POON KA-YEUNG (Steven Ma), who was serving as a combat medic, returns to his hometown, taking over the reins. Apart from his discovery of HAU-YEE's dubious death, the best friend of the late HAU-YEE, TONG BING-BING (Tavia Yeung) also has a feeling of suspicion, so the two decide to launch an investigation.

programme.title: King Of Snooker, The
programme.desc: The all-conquering snooker player YAU YAT KIU (Cheng Siu Chau, Adam) takes everyone by surprise when he suddenly retires from the snooker world. This comes as a huge disappointed to her daughter YAU KA KAN (Niki Chow), who has always wanted to follow in his footsteps. She feels bewildered too, for although KIU pretends he does not care about the snooker any more, he has set up an extremely difficult game in his restaurant. His purpose cannot be more obvious: he is waiting for someone to solve the game. KIU comes to know KAN TSZ HIM (Patrick Tang) by chance. Noticing his flair for the snooker, KIU decides to make an exception for HIM and teaches him all he knows about the game. Later, KAN manages to persuade her father into taking her in as well.

programme.title: Brick Slaves
programme.desc: LAU YIU-MING (Vincent Wong) exhausts the money that he and his girlfriend have saved for many years to buy a property and is about to get married. Out of the blue, his girlfriend not only wants to break up with him, but also secretly leases the premises out to a piano teacher, CHOI KIN-CHING (Selena Li). Unfortunately, YIU-MING's bad day gets even worse as he is soon laid off from work. In order to continue to pay the mortgage, YIU-MING has no other choice but to accept the unreasonable condition imposed by KIN-CHING, however the two often have arguments due to their differences in lifestyles. Later on, YIU-MING unveils that there is quite a story behind KIN-CHING's personality that makes everyone keep a distance from her. Eventually, YIU-MING finds a new job with a property management company. Unknown to him, his arrival ruins LO PIT-TAT's (Mak Cheung Ching) hope of getting promoted, so PIT-TAT, a third-generation brick slave, for the sake of keeping his own job becomes completely incompatible with YIU-MING at work. Nevertheless, YIU-MING gains recognition from his boss, LI OI-WAH (Sheung Tin Ngor), who even urges him to specifically look after a trainee called CHUK PIK-KEI (Eliza Sam). Due to their work, YIU-MING and PIK-KEI get to observe the world around the brick slaves. PIK-KEI gradually falls in love with YIU-MING, yet YIU-MING knows very well whom he really loves. All of a sudden, KIN-CHING requests to end the tenancy......

programme.title: Unchained Medleyr
programme.desc: Pop musician Ding Yat-chun (Owen Cheung) is often troubled by nightmares. He then gets embroiled in a plagiarism scandal, so he moves to a small village for the time being as he also wants to relax. Yat-chun unwittingly opens an old Cantonese opera costume trunk in the village house, releasing the ghost of opera diva Wan Lau-fong (Katy Kung). In the 1990s, Lau-fong was a Cantonese opera diva, but she passed away due to some accident. Lau-fong has forgotten almost everything about her human life. And she only wants to track down her crush Kuk Hang-wan from yesteryear. Yat-chun agrees to help as he wants to assist Lau-fong in fulfilling her wish. While they get along, a human and a ghost support each other, and they gradually fall in love. However, someone finds out about Lau-fong's ghost. They are afraid of the truth behind her death being exposed, so they decide to cover up everything at all costs.

programme.title: Rosy Business
programme.desc: HONG PO KEI's (Tang Shui Man, Sheren) engagement with Wuxi rice baron TSEUNG KIU (Yueh Wah) broke off many years ago when a natural disaster hit the country. Later when the country was running out of food supply her whole family was killed and she become a criminal. Over the years, KEI has never got over KIU. She has been trying to prove he is not as heartless as the others think. Fate has it that they meet again and she becomes his fourth wife. KIU's first and second wives, YAN FUNG YEE (Tse Suet Sum) and PANG KIU (Sheung Tin Ngor, Kiki), always make things difficult for KEI. KEI, who is an extremely clever person who never wastes time on trivial things, turns every threat into an opportunity. This makes KIU appreciate her wisdom and persistence. He entrusts his business to her and tells her to find a suitable successor for him before he dies. Despite all the attacks in the family, KEI manages to keep the business in good shape. She has never forgotten KIU's last wish, too. By chance, she discovers that TSEUNG PIT CHING (Ng Cheuk Hai, Ron), KIU's second son, is not really a playboy but an upright person loved by everyone in the shop. She therefore guides and helps him in every possible way, but her efforts are met with CHAI KAU's (Lai Yiu Cheung) challenges. KAU seeks vengeance for being mistreated and wants a pay back from TSEUNG family. After rounds after rounds of battle wits and actual fights, KEI and KAU begin to appreciate each other. KAU even falls for KEI as time goes by…

programme.title: Storm In A Cocoon
programme.desc: Wing Tai Lung is the silk kingdom in Canton during the early years of Republic China. Its owner POON WING-NIN (Yueh Hua), because of his advanced age, has handed over the charge to his elder son POON KA-HIN (Evergreen Mak) and daughter POON HAU-YEE (Hong Wah). Unfortunately, YIU-MING's bad day gets even worse as he is soon laid off from work. In order to continue to pay the mortgage, YIU-MING has no other choice but to accept the unreasonable condition imposed by KIN-CHING, however the two often have arguments due to their differences in lifestyles. Later on, YIU-MING unveils that there is quite a story behind KIN-CHING's personality that makes everyone keep a distance from her. Eventually, YIU-MING finds a new job with a property management company. Unknown to him, his arrival ruins LO PIT-TAT's (Mak Cheung Ching) hope of getting promoted, so PIT-TAT, a third-generation brick slave, for the sake of keeping his own job becomes completely incompatible with YIU-MING at work. Nevertheless, YIU-MING gains recognition from his boss, LI OI-WAH (Sheung Tin Ngor), who even urges him to specifically look after a trainee called CHUK PIK-KEI (Eliza Sam). Due to their work, YIU-MING and PIK-KEI get to observe the world around the brick slaves. PIK-KEI gradually falls in love with YIU-MING, yet YIU-MING knows very well whom he really loves. All of a sudden, KIN-CHING requests to end the tenancy......

programme.title: Unchained Medleyr
programme.desc: Pop musician Ding Yat-chun (Owen Cheung) is often troubled by nightmares. He then gets embroiled in a plagiarism scandal, so he moves to a small village for the time being as he also wants to relax. Yat-chun unwittingly opens an old Cantonese opera costume trunk in the village house, releasing the ghost of opera diva Wan Lau-fong (Katy Kung). In the 1990s, Lau-fong was a Cantonese opera diva, but she passed away due to some accident. Lau-fong has forgotten almost everything about her human life. And she only wants to track down her crush Kuk Hang-wan from yesteryear. Yat-chun agrees to help as he wants to assist Lau-fong in fulfilling her wish. While they get along, a human and a ghost support each other, and they gradually fall in love. However, someone finds out about Lau-fong's ghost. They are afraid of the truth behind her death being exposed, so they decide to cover up everything at all costs.

programme.title: Rosy Business
programme.desc: HONG PO KEI's (Tang Shui Man, Sheren) engagement with Wuxi rice baron TSEUNG KIU (Yueh Wah) broke off many years ago when a natural disaster hit the country. Later when the country was running out of food supply her whole family was killed and she become a criminal. Over the years, KEI has never got over KIU. She has been trying to prove he is not as heartless as the others think. Fate has it that they meet again and she becomes his fourth wife. KIU's first and second wives, YAN FUNG YEE (Tse Suet Sum) and PANG KIU (Sheung Tin Ngor, Kiki), always make things difficult for KEI. KEI, who is an extremely clever person who never wastes time on trivial things, turns every threat into an opportunity. This makes KIU appreciate her wisdom and persistence. He entrusts his business to her and tells her to find a suitable successor for him before he dies. Despite all the attacks in the family, KEI manages to keep the business in good shape. She has never forgotten KIU's last wish, too. By chance, she discovers that TSEUNG PIT CHING (Ng Cheuk Hai, Ron), KIU's second son, is not really a playboy but an upright person loved by everyone in the shop. She therefore guides and helps him in every possible way, but her efforts are met with CHAI KAU's (Lai Yiu Cheung) challenges. KAU seeks vengeance for being mistreated and wants a pay back from TSEUNG family. After rounds after rounds of battle wits and actual fights, KEI and KAU begin to appreciate each other. KAU even falls for KEI as time goes by…

programme.title: Storm In A Cocoon
programme.desc: Wing Tai Lung is the silk kingdom in Canton during the early years of Republic China. Its owner POON WING-NIN (Yueh Hua), because of his advanced age, has handed over the charge to his elder son POON KA-HIN (Evergreen Mak) and daughter POON HAU-YEE (Hong Wah). Out of the blue, HAU-YEE commits suicide, so his second son POON KA-YEUNG (Steven Ma), who was serving as a combat medic, returns to his hometown, taking over the reins. Apart from his discovery of HAU-YEE's dubious death, the best friend of the late HAU-YEE, TONG BING-BING (Tavia Yeung) also has a feeling of suspicion, so the two decide to launch an investigation.

programme.title: King Of Snooker, The
programme.desc: The all-conquering snooker player YAU YAT KIU (Cheng Siu Chau, Adam) takes everyone by surprise when he suddenly retires from the snooker world. This comes as a huge disappointed to her daughter YAU KA KAN (Niki Chow), who has always wanted to follow in his footsteps. She feels bewildered too, for although KIU pretends he does not care about the snooker any more, he has set up an extremely difficult game in his restaurant. His purpose cannot be more obvious: he is waiting for someone to solve the game. KIU comes to know KAN TSZ HIM (Patrick Tang) by chance. Noticing his flair for the snooker, KIU decides to make an exception for HIM and teaches him all he knows about the game. Later, KAN manages to persuade her father into taking her in as well.

programme.title: My Daughter Is A Zombie
programme.desc: Filem Ini Mengisahkan Tentang Seorang Lelaki Berusaha Melindungi Anak Perempuannya Yang Dijangkiti Virus Zombi, Sehingga Pihak Berkuasa Menemui Penawar Yang Memulihkan Anaknya. Lee Jung-hwan, Seorang Penjinak Haiwan Yang Hidup Bahagia Bersama Anak Perempuannya, Soo-ah. Namun Keadaan Berubah Apabila Virus Gar Mula Merebak Di Bandar Dan Sesiapa Yang Dijangkiti Akan Bertukar Menjadi Zombi. Dalam Usaha Mereka Melarikan Diri Ke Kampung Halaman, Soo-ah Turut Dijangkiti. Walau Bagaimanapun, Jung-hwan Tetap Membawa Soo-ah Pulang Ke Kampungnya, Eunbong-ri, Tempat Ibunya Kim Bam-soon Tinggal. Jung-hwan Berusaha Sedaya Upaya Menyembunyikan Keadaan Soo-ah Agar Dia Tidak Dibawa Pergi Atau Dibunuh Oleh Pihak Berkuasa. Jung-hwan Kemudian Melatih Soo-ah Untuk Mengawal Naluri Zombinya Dengan Harapan Dia Tidak Mencederakan Sesiapa. Walaupun Soo-ah Telah Bertukar Menjadi Zombi, Dia Masih Menunjukkan Sifat Kemanusiaan Yang Membuatkan Jung-hwan Dan Bam-soon Berharap Untuk Memulihkannya. Tidak Lama Kemudian, Shin Yeon-hwa, Rakan Lama Jung-hwan Telah Mengetahui Rahsia Tersebut Dan Pada Mulanya Berniat Membunuh Soo-ah. Namun Niatnya Berubah Apabila Dia Melihat Soo-ah Masih Memiliki Naluri Manusia. Yeon-hwa Kemudian Membantu Soo-ah Menyesuaikan Diri Dengan Masyarakat Serta Menjaga Rahsia Jangkitan Itu. Namun, Keadaan Menjadi Huru-hara Apabila Jung-hwan Membawa Soo-ah Ke Taman Hiburan Dan Tingkah Laku Aneh Soo-ah Menarik Perhatian Netizen. Pihak Berkuasa Mula Memburunya. Jung-hwan Berusaha Melindungi Dan Melarikan Anaknya, Tetapi Dia Ditembak Sebelum Sempat Melaksanakan Rancangannya. Tindak Balas Luar Biasa Soo-ah Selepas Itu Mengejutkan Anggota Tentera Yang Mengejarnya. Akhirnya Mereka Dibawa Kepada Para Saintis, Yang Mendapati Darah Jung-hwan Mengandungi Penawar Virus Tersebut. Mereka Menjalankan Kajian Dan Berjaya Menyembuhkan Jangkitan Dalam Tubuh Soo-ah. Soo-ah Akhirnya Pulih, Namun Jung-hwan Kekal Dalam Keadaan Koma.
